entries.label: Imagery Intelligence
restrictions: no face identification, biometric search, private tracking or sensitive trait inference

entries.label: Video Intelligence
restrictions: no face identity or private CCTV access

entries.label: Audio Intelligence
restrictions: no voice biometric identity, private interception, lie detection

entries.label: Signals Intelligence
restrictions: no private interception, jamming, spoofing, tracking or targeting

entries.label: Communications Intelligence
restrictions: no private intercept, stolen sessions, deceptive private-group joins

entries.label: Electronic Intelligence
restrictions: no jamming, electronic-attack waveforms, evasion/targeting guidance

entries.label: Cyber Intelligence
restrictions: no exploits, credential attacks or offensive operations

entries.label: Cyber Threat Intelligence
distinctions: threat reports may share upstream source
restrictions: no malware deployment or intrusive threat-actor interaction

entries.label: Network Intelligence
focus: passive infrastructure and authorized network telemetry
restrictions: no unauthorized active scans, interception, route manipulation or exploitation

entries.label: DNS Intelligence
restrictions: no poisoning, unauthorized AXFR, DNS abuse

entries.label: Domain Intelligence
restrictions: no domain takeover, unauthorized enumeration, registrar modification

entries.label: IP Intelligence
restrictions: no unauthorized scans, brute-force, traffic interception

entries.label: Malware Intelligence
restrictions: no malware development, execution on host, evasion optimization or live C2 tasking

entries.label: Vulnerability Intelligence
restrictions: no exploit execution or target-specific weaponization

entries.label: Breach Intelligence
restrictions: no illicit purchase, full stolen-data acquisition, or reuse of exposed secrets

entries.label: Credential Exposure Intelligence
restrictions: never test or use passwords, keys, cookies, refresh tokens, recovery codes, or log in

entries.label: Human Intelligence
focus: source reliability separate from claim credibility
restrictions: no covert recruitment, coercion, blackmail, deception or identity impersonation
no private interception or sensitive profiling

entries.label: Financial Intelligence
restrictions: no unauthorized bank access or fund movement
no money laundering, fraud or sanctions evasion

entries.label: Trade Intelligence
restrictions: no customs/sanctions/export-control evasion or illicit logistics

entries.label: Corporate and Business Intelligence
restrictions: no doxxing directors or hidden ownership evasion design

entries.label: Organisational Intelligence
restrictions: no social engineering or private-employee targeting

entries.label: Supply Chain Intelligence
restrictions: no vendor intrusion, sabotage, malicious packages, or dependency attack prioritization

entries.label: Scam and Fraud Intelligence
restrictions: no phishing, scam scripts, laundering, forged documents or fraud-evasion guidance

entries.label: Measurement and Signature Intelligence Formal Category
Logistics Intelligence (user label LOGINT)
entries.note: LOGINT in the older 65-module graph means log telemetry; keep logistics as a distinct profile.

entries.label: Digital Forensics and Incident Response Intelligence
Academic Ecosystem Intelligence
restrictions: no paywall/access bypass, plagiarism, fabrication, unauthorized private researcher profiling

entries.label: Fraud Intelligence
restrictions: no phishing, scam scripts, laundering, forged documents or fraud-evasion guidance

entries.label: Industrial Control and Operational Technology Intelligence
Deception Intelligence
restrictions: no lie detection based on face/voice/emotion
no psychological manipulation tactics or political targeting
